title: Local Source Revision Identity
purpose: Defines the exact commit identity of reusable framework material already present in a local source Git repository, using the repository's native object format.

normative_requirements.text: A local source revision identity shall uniquely identify an exact commit object in the explicitly supplied local source Git repository; the source is a local Git repository, and the revision must resolve directly to a commit object via `git rev-parse --verify <revision>^{commit}`.

The commit tree of the resolved commit shall be the sole source-content authority for all material selection, installation, and inventory operations; the working tree of the source repository shall be ignored.

The revision identity shall use the canonical Git object identity representation defined by product.git-object-identity, with object_format "sha1" and the object_id shall be exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

All required Git objects (commit, tree, and referenced blobs and subtrees) must already exist locally in the source repository; the initializer shall reject a revision whose objects are not fully available without performing a remote fetch, named-reference resolution, or object transfer.

The initializer shall reject any source revision whose resolution requires: named-reference resolution (branch, tag, or remote-tracking name), remote fetch or network access, Git replacement-object behavior, Git submodule checkout or initialization, or LFS pointer resolution.

Symbolic links in the source commit tree shall be handled according to the declared material-manifest entry: when the manifest entry source_type is `symlink`, the link target text shall be copied as the destination symlink target when the destination filesystem supports symbolic links; when the manifest entry does not declare symlink support or the filesystem does not support symbolic links, the entry shall be rejected.
The supported Git object format for Version 1 shall be SHA-1 only; the initializer shall reject any source repository whose native object format is not SHA-1.
The source revision identity shall be explicit and immutable; named-reference resolution, remote lookup, and remote retrieval are outside this contract.
